seeds.summary: The visible More info button works with a pointer but is absent from every D-pad edge.
All remote directions remain inside the profile picker and Back is ignored; only its pointer close control exits.
RIGHT from the third continue-watching card jumps to the distant footer Privacy control instead of the adjacent fourth card.
Back from content details opens Search even when details was entered from Home.
Text Colour is visible and pointer-clickable but Font Size DOWN skips to Background, leaving no D-pad path to it.

termination.detail: The queued branch could not be restored from the current verified live state without a root relaunch.
Unsafe root replay requires BACK; the queued branch was not reconstructed without a verified live state.
